storySession.fullStory: Your child is missing and you hear a loud ruido (noise) from above the house, so you run outside and look up to see your trapped on the techo (roof). You climb up to reach your, but you is stuck too far away on the edge. You carry a columpio (swing) up to the roof and hang it near your so you can grab it, but when you tries to move toward it, your jacket cremallera (zipper) catches on the swing chain and holds your frozen. You begin a quick búsqueda (search) across the roof and find a small knife to carefully cut the fabric free from the zipper. You light a vela (candle) to see the tangled threads better and work until the cremallera releases completely. Your daughter is still frightened and won't reach for the swing, so you blow a burbuja (bubble) toward your to calm your down. You watches it float and relax enough to grab the swing and swing back to you, where you give your a tight abrazo (hug) and carry your safely down.
